item.title: Comptroller warns of budget deficit, health insurance risks
item.description: New York State's proposed budget for 2027 faces a potential $27.5 billion deficit by 2030 due to federal cuts, which could result in 1 million New Yorkers losing health insurance, but the state's $3.5 billion surplus could help prevent these cuts.

item.title: State bill introduced to tackle high energy costs
item.description: State Senator Chris Ryan is pushing for a package of bills to protect ratepayers and hold utility providers accountable, including measures to increase transparency and limit expenditures, as families across Central New York struggle with high energy bills.

item.title: Governor Hochul Proposes Tax on Nicotine Pouches
item.description: According to a 2025 World Health Organization report, one in five adults, globally, are addicted to tobacco. Governor Hochul proposed in her Executive Budget for FY 2027 to broaden the tobacco products’ definition to include nicotine. This would cause nicotine pouch products such as Zyn, Velo, and On! to carry a 75% wholesale tax.

item.title: Schumer, Gillibrand announce funds for new bus facility in Utica
item.description: New York Senators Chuck Schumer and Kirsten Gillibrand have announced that the City of Utica will receive funding to improve its bus transit facility.

item.title: Redrawing New York City's only GOP congressional seat as election deadlines loom
item.description: New York's Appellate Division allowed the state's redistricting commission to begin redrawing district lines for the only Republican-held congressional seat in New York City, after a lower court order invalidated the 11th Congressional District, days before candidates are supposed to start collecting signatures to get on the ballot.

item.title: Herkimer Police seize large quantity of marijuana, pills in raid
item.description: Herkimer Police arrested a man on Thursday after a large quantity of drugs was found in an apartment in the village.
